## 1 Purpose and Commitment

Meridian Relief Trust protects the people it serves from harm caused by anyone acting in its name.

## 2 Scope and Application

This policy applies to every member of staff, volunteer, and partner engaged by the Trust.

## 3 Definitions

Safeguarding means protecting people from harm arising from contact with the organisation.

## 4 Prohibited Conduct

No member of staff may exploit, abuse, or harass a person connected to the Trust's work.

## 5 Duty to Report

Every person covered by this policy must report a known or suspected violation without delay.
